seo.title: ChatSched — Managed Advertising, Marketplace & Publisher Network
seo.description: South African advertising for small businesses: build a managed campaign with ChatSched or browse local advertising placements and send requests through the platform.

hero.subtitle: Tell us your goal and budget — we build the campaign. Or browse real local pages, podcasts and radio slots yourself. Either way, it is tracked from request to proof.
hero.secure: Payment held securely until your placement is confirmed live

audienceSplit.heading: Whichever side you're on, it's built for you.
audienceSplit.businessTitle: Reach the audience your customers already trust
audienceSplit.businessBody: R399, once-off, gets you the marketplace, managed campaigns and a R199 launch credit included. No renewal, ever. Browsing is free — sending a request needs that one-time activation.
audienceSplit.publisherTitle: Monetise the audience you've already built
audienceSplit.publisherBody: R199, once-off, for full Publisher Network access — approve requests, set your own price, opportunities, earnings and analytics. No renewal, ever. Listing a basic profile stays free.

layers.title: However you want to advertise, there is a way in.
layers.subtitle: Three layers. One platform behind them. Your campaign stays in the same tracked workflow from request to proof.
layers.agencyBody: Tell us the goal, audience and budget. We plan and manage the campaign with you.
layers.marketplaceBody: Discover real inventory, compare options and choose where you want to advertise.
layers.networkBody: Already have an audience? Turn your page, site, podcast, radio inventory or other opportunity into advertising supply.

featured.title: Some of the pages already on the board.
featured.subtitle: A handful of the pages and groups already live on ChatSched — more join every week.
featured.emptyDescription: Add the first one from the admin panel to fill this in.

channelsSection.title: Choose the way your customers already pay attention.
channelsSection.subtitle: Choose from 11 live advertising channels. Minibus Taxi & Transport Media and Spaza Shops & Township Traders are the only two channels still in development.

valueProp.badge: Why not just run social ads?
valueProp.title1: Zero ad spend wasted on algorithms.
valueProp.title2: 100% aimed at people who already trust the page.
valueProp.body: Social ad platforms bid your budget against a black box and hope the right person scrolls past at the right second. ChatSched puts you directly in front of an audience a real local creator already built — no auction, no algorithm, no guessing.

howItWorks.scene2Title: Send a request, or review one

payment.title: A clear payment flow, from approval to live placement.
payment.step1: Business requests, creator approves — or it auto-closes after {{days}} days of no response.
payment.step2: Business pays through the ChatSched payment flow after the request is approved — payment is not released to the publisher before the agreed release condition.
payment.step3: Creator is paid out within {{hours}} hours of going live — {{share}}% to the creator, a flat {{commission}}% platform fee.

activeChannels.body: From social pages and creators to radio, websites, podcasts, sports, events, communities, business networks, restaurants and in-venue screens, the idea stays simple: reach people where attention already exists.

opportunities.subtitle: Businesses can publish targeted briefs. Publishers can discover relevant opportunities and pitch without exposing private contact details. ChatSched keeps the conversation, proposals and workflow on-platform.

opportunities.businessBody: Need a school partnership, event sponsor, newsletter placement, venue display, influencer product placement or radio/podcast spot? Publish the brief and reach verified supply.
opportunities.publisherBody: Discover opportunities that match your channel, audience and location — then respond through ChatSched.
